summary: Time-based race message dispatcher. Gated on a race-active flag (dword_7D0308) and a nonzero track-condition float (flt_7CF3C8). Computes elapsed time v6 = a1 - dbl_8AFEA0 and cumulative time v4 = dbl_8AFE98 + v6; as cumulative time crosses descending thresholds (2700s, 1800s, 900s, 600s, 300s, 180s), selects a message selector (35, 34, 277, 276, 279, 278) and inserts a driver-table entry: struct initialized with sentinel values, populated via driver-data lookup/time conversion with -1 driver indices and -2.0 sentinel floats, then InsertDriverTableEntry into the table rooted at flt_5EA618. When elapsed falls to <= 0.0, invokes a virtual thiscall at vtable offset 12 on dword_5EB10C (labeled SoundSystemPtr, DERIVED) and reinitializes the flt_5EA618 buffer via BufferInitWith10fDefaults. Called by PitTimer (0x004D2E50).

local_names.v5: driver-table entry struct (8 floats), initialized then populated then inserted

operations.description: Race-session gate: proceed only if dword_7D0308 is nonzero.
Track-condition gate: proceed only if flt_7CF3C8 is not 0.0.
Compute elapsed time v6 = a1 - dbl_8AFEA0 (argument time minus stored reference/session-offset time).
If elapsed v6 is not below 2700.0, exit without dispatching.
Compute cumulative time v4 = dbl_8AFE98 + v6 (stored accumulated time plus elapsed).
If cumulative v4 >= 2700.0, select the 2700-second milestone message.
Set message selector v3 = 35 for the 2700-second milestone.
Shared dispatch path: StructInitWithSentinelValues(v5); DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion(v5, v3, -1, -1, -1, -1, -2.0, -2.0); InsertDriverTableEntry(flt_5EA618, v5).
Exit after dispatching a message entry.
If elapsed v6 < 1800.0, continue descending threshold checks.
If cumulative v4 >= 1800.0, select the 1800-second milestone message.
Set message selector v3 = 34 for the 1800-second milestone.
If elapsed v6 < 900.0, continue descending threshold checks.
If cumulative v4 >= 900.0, select the 900-second milestone message.
Set message selector v3 = 277 for the 900-second milestone.
If elapsed v6 < 600.0, continue descending threshold checks.
If cumulative v4 >= 600.0, select the 600-second milestone message.
Set message selector v3 = 276 for the 600-second milestone.
If elapsed v6 < 300.0, continue descending threshold checks.
If cumulative v4 >= 300.0, select the 300-second milestone message.
Set message selector v3 = 279 for the 300-second milestone.
If elapsed v6 < 180.0, continue descending threshold checks.
If cumulative v4 >= 180.0, select the 180-second milestone message.
Set message selector v3 = 278 for the 180-second milestone.
If elapsed v6 <= 0.0, take the reset/cleanup branch.
If dword_5EB10C (labeled SoundSystemPtr, DERIVED) is nonzero, invoke its vtable method at offset 12 (thiscall).
Virtual thiscall dispatch on dword_5EB10C reading the pointer at vtable offset 12 (third virtual method).
BufferInitWith10fDefaults(flt_5EA618): reinitialize the driver-table/buffer rooted at flt_5EA618 with sentinel defaults.
